lines.zh: 我一步一步走，石屑掉在身后。
lines.en: I walk, leaving stone dust behind.
Crystals on me. They clink as I walk.
Heavy body. Every step lands.
Slow. Crystals grind against my hide.
I walk with my head tilted. Heavy neck.

lines.zh: 地上的草被我踩成灰色。
lines.en: The grass greys under my steps.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚往轰鸣那边去。
lines.en: I drag my feet toward the rumbling.

lines.zh: 我的脚步有节奏，像计数。
lines.en: My steps keep a rhythm. Like counting.
I avoid my own kind. Rather not touch.
Steady. Like stone.

lines.zh: 晶簇在肩上，走一步亮一下。
lines.en: Crystals on my shoulder. They catch light each step.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，压出一道痕。
lines.en: Low to the ground, leaving a groove.
I stand. The crystals grow slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬手看，皮下面是硬的。
lines.en: I look at my hand. Hard beneath the skin.

lines.zh: 源石的味，从我身上散出去。
lines.en: The smell of originium comes off me.
I don't roar. Too loud when I do.

lines.zh: 我低头，看着自己的影子。
lines.en: I look down at my own shadow.
The wind here carries dust.
Counting every sound I can hear.

lines.zh: 我身上的一块晶，今天掉过一次。
lines.en: A piece of crystal fell off me today.
I turn slowly. Bones crack.

lines.zh: 我什么都不想做，就站着。
lines.en: I don't want to do anything. Just stand.
Originium has clotted in my blood.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶体比你的刀硬。
lines.en: The crystal on me is harder than your blade.
Your breathing isn't steady.
Head tilted. My neck is stiff.

lines.zh: 一百点源石，全在这身壳里。
lines.en: A hundred points of Originium, all in this shell.
I'm judging, looking like this.
If you leave, I will just watch from here.
I never want to strike first.

lines.zh: 你身上没有源石的痕迹。
lines.en: No originium traces on you.
We stand. Neither speaks.
A crystal chipped.

lines.zh: 石头擦过我，留下一道白印。
lines.en: The stone grazes me and leaves a white streak.
Thick hide. Something inside, though.
That hurt. Really hurt.
I swayed, and the originium held me up.
You knocked a crystal loose.
Not angry. Displeased.
That shook my bones.
Took a moment to see you again.
Care to try again?
Iron? I smell iron.
Not edible. Still useful.
Hold it up. Let me look.
Originium ore suits me better.

lines.zh: 搁在石头上，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: Set it on the rock and I will shuffle over.
My hide can't eat that.
That smell reminds me of a vein.
Don't hold it that close.
I reach out, then pull back.

lines.zh: 那些发亮的源石，我要收着。
lines.en: Those glowing originium shards, I will keep them.
You hit me like stone.
One step back. The soil dips.
My crystals scraped you.
Don't press against me. Originium transfers.
I didn't shove. You were in the way.
After the bump, I held.
Lighter than I expected.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被我们踩起来了。
lines.en: We kicked up the ash.
Originium knots my shoulder — half a step aside.
Too heavy. I can't yield.

lines.zh: 我们这种，凑在一起不容易。
lines.en: Our kind. Hard to find each other.

lines.zh: 我身上有晶体，会刮到你。
lines.en: Crystals on me. They'd scrape you.

lines.zh: 源石在体内，会传给下一代。
lines.en: The originium passes to the next.
Stand side by side first. Easy.

lines.zh: 我不知道这算不算亲近。
lines.en: I don't know if this counts as closeness.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我就把晶体侧开。
lines.en: Come near. I'll turn my crystals aside.
This vein is enough for us.
I turn my head slowly. Don't want to frighten you.
My back's hard. Don't lean on it.
This is enough. No more needed.

lines.zh: 我把这块源石翻过来看。
lines.en: I turn this originium shard over in my hand.
Smells of originium.
In my hand, it cools.

lines.zh: 地上还有别的，我一起拿。
lines.en: More on the ground. Taking it all.
Fingers too thick. It slipped.
Tucked into a crystal gap.
Yours? I'll hold it.
Not heavy. Doesn't matter.
One sniff. Dirt.
Inedible. Keeping it anyway.
You're walking in the ash. I hear it.
I turn. My crystals catch the light.
Just the two of us here.
I come toward you, slowly.
Something on you is chiming.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，但我还在犹豫。
lines.en: Locked on. Still hesitating.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我注意到了。
lines.en: Your steps broke rhythm. Noticed.
I've started moving. Watch.

lines.zh: 我正看着源石，你插进来了。
lines.en: I was watching the originium, and you cut in.

lines.zh: 你站在矿脉边上，很危险。
lines.en: You're standing by the vein. Dangerous.
Originium crystals on my shoulders.
I know this vein well.
You touched me just now.
I can't retreat. Only forward.

lines.zh: 现在我知道了你的位置。
lines.en: Now I know where you are.
Every crystal lit at once.

lines.zh: 我粘结着地，慢慢逼过去。
lines.en: The crystals grind as I close in.
You retreat. The ground speaks.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶体越来越亮。
lines.en: The crystals on me are brightening.
You go around the rock. So do I.
I don't need speed. I have weight.
Your blade will roll over.
The ground you stand on trembles faintly.

lines.zh: 这一片的灰，都是我踩的。
lines.en: All this ash is from my steps.

lines.zh: 你再退，就退到矿脉里了。
lines.en: Keep backing and you'll be in the vein.
The hum of the originium grows closer.
I raise a hand. Slowly.
You should leave now.
I don't really want this.
But you've already come too close.
Originium glows on my shoulder.
I moved. Right now.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的影子长，压过去了。
lines.en: My shadow runs past yours.

lines.zh: 你踩着灰后退，脚印很清楚。
lines.en: You back through the ash. Clear prints.

lines.zh: 我一动，身上的晶体就照亮周围。
lines.en: When I move, the crystals light the area.
What you're holding will break first.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍下去，土都翻了。
lines.en: One slap and the soil turns over.

lines.zh: 手上的晶体扎进你肩膀。
lines.en: My crystals bite your shoulder.
Body check. Most direct.

lines.zh: 这一下，我听见你骨头响。
lines.en: I heard your ribs.

lines.zh: 你被我推得退了好几步。
lines.en: I pushed you back several steps.

lines.zh: 源石在我背上结成了块。
lines.en: Originium crusts on my back.

lines.zh: 晶体在你护甲上划出白痕。
lines.en: Crystals left white streaks on your armor.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下去，地都陷了。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the ground sinks.
No point blocking.
That hurt my hand too.
I held you down.
Your weapon hit the ground.
I stepped back to recover.
You are still standing; I press again.
That was everything I had.
The ground has a crater now.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腰带，往上一提。
lines.en: I grab your belt and lift.

lines.zh: 晶体边缘划开你的袖子。
lines.en: A crystal edge opened your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我这一下，把石头都打碎了。
lines.en: That blow shattered the stone.
You retreat. I'm in no hurry. I have weight.
I stand up beside the vein.

lines.zh: 身上晶体一开始是暗的。
lines.en: The crystals start dark.

lines.zh: 灰落下来，我才看清自己。
lines.en: The ash settled and I saw myself.
There's originium under this ground.
Two steps before I held steady.
Light seeps through the crystals.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，地面陷了。
lines.en: I landed. The ground gave.
People should step back.
I remember being a person.
This body isn't anymore.
First breath tastes of ore dust.
I raise a hand and look a long time.

lines.zh: 火烧起来，我身上的矿在发光。
lines.en: Fire, and the ore in me glows.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候砸出了坑。
lines.en: Falling, I made a crater.

lines.zh: 水里有源石味，我不敢呼吸。
lines.en: Originium in the water. I don't dare breathe.

lines.zh: 炸得我身上的晶体乱响。
lines.en: The blast set every crystal ringing.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的晶体之间。
lines.en: Something lodged between my crystals.

lines.zh: 这力量让源石在体内乱动。
lines.en: That power set the ore moving inside me.

lines.zh: 没有矿，我开始变得很虚。
lines.en: No ore. I'm going weak.
Lightning. My crystals all conduct.
Falling. Still growing crystal.
